title: Qammaxxaaga sinni reeda
intro: Dumaahi baaxooxal, caylale reeda inki adda lowsis gubat hayteh, mango gadda kee lowsis sinni marih manoh amrisak sugte. qado astooti kee maabitina tanim takkay immay, ta miraaciini gita dooreh, waktit qagaaqagitak qilsi boodut miraacise.
clues: Anu ellecabo cayla kee reeda fidin exxal yoh taguudeh.
Anu inkih tan nummah degelti ruube rammitle farmoytal gexkalit abe.
Yi ummatta kaxxa rikkissoo kee ni qasriinoh sarrimaaneh yan daqaaral tamixxigeh sugte.
Anu mango cakkumuk tan astootih sumaq suge, adoytit baaxoh alluwwa fan kortam kee gaba urta.
Anu naqoosa butta yi baaxok tawqem cineh, yallih amritte takkay immay.
Yi gexo ummattah kattat yoo kee yi qande kurruume badih sorkocô baxat fan beyte.
arabic: فَٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ فَأَغْرَقْنَـٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ بِأَنَّهُمْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا وَكَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا غَـٰفِلِينَ
verse: So We took retribution from them, and We drowned them in the sea because they denied Our signs and were heedless of them. (7:136)
